description: Original offline round survival content for FPS Mode, inspired by classic survival mechanics.

original_content.geometry: Authored procedurally in game/maps/zombies_map_builder.gd; existing CC0 props retain their source manifests.
original_content.characters: Original primitive character was replaced by the attributed Pixelhouse zombie (2009), CC BY 3.0. Runtime normalization, material variants, leg-triangle removal, crawler hand IK and integration are FPS Mode adaptations.
original_content.weapons_and_machines: Original procedural models and chalk silhouettes in game/zombies/.
original_content.audio: 24 original deterministic synthesized WAV cues generated by tools/synthesize_zombies_audio.py. No sampled Call of Duty audio.
original_content.branding: No Call of Duty maps, characters, textures, logos, recordings, or extracted assets are distributed.
